# Circus Circus Hotel & Casino Las Vegas

> > A family-friendly Las Vegas hotel and casino featuring the Adventuredome theme park, The Midway arcade, and diverse dining options on the Las Vegas Strip.

Circus Circus Hotel & Casino Las Vegas is a classic Vegas destination known for its circus-themed entertainment, indoor Adventuredome theme park, and family-oriented attractions. The property offers multiple hotel towers including the Manor Motor Lodge and Casino Tower, along with dining venues like The Steak House, Pizzeria, and Circus Buffet.

## Key Topics

- Adventuredome theme park
- The Midway arcade and games
- The Steak House dining
- Las Vegas Strip location
- Family entertainment
- Casino Tower and Manor Motor Lodge
- Midway Playcard
- Classic Arcade
- Fear Zone attractions
- Circus Buffet
- Pizzeria and Big Top Eats
- Las Vegas casino gaming
- Hotel booking and rooms
- Circus-themed entertainment
